links.outcome: Vulnerabilities found by automated security audit agent during 90-day deployment
links.effect: Automated security audit agent discovered four HIGH severity findings over 90 days, all remediated; fleet hardened across three VM image generations.
links.quote: We report results from 90 days of deployment including four HIGH severity findings discovered and remediated by an automated security audit agent, progressive fleet hardening across three VM image generations, and defense coverage mapped to all eleven attack patterns from recent literature.

unlisted_practices: Kernel-level workload isolation of agent containers (gVisor on Kubernetes)
Credential proxy sidecars preventing agent access to raw secrets
Prompt integrity framework with structured metadata envelopes and untrusted content labeling
Automated audit agent for fleet configuration drift

screen.reason: Empirical study describing the real-world deployment and evaluation of a zero trust security architecture and guardrail defense-in-depth system for nine autonomous AI agents in production at a healthcare technology company over 90 days.

primary.practice: zero trust security architecture and prompt integrity guardrails
